pieces.Text: Element air, fire, or water; Type form infusion; Level 3; Burn 2 Associated Blasts air, blizzard, blue flame, charged water, fire, magma, mud, plasma, sandstorm, steam, thunderstorm, water Saving Throw Reflex half A torrent of energy buffets or burns all foes in a 30-foot line, dealing half your normal amount of blast damage (or full damage for energy blasts). The saving throw DC is Dexterity-based.
